about: Kirloskar Brothers Limited provides fluid management solutions worldwide. The company manufactures various pumps, including utility, solid handling, process, split-case, multi-stage, sump, vertical inline and turbine, non-clog submersible, special engineered, firefighting, and nuclear pumps; and sluice/gate, non-return/check, globe, air, ball, suction diffuser, triple duty, and butterfly valves. It also provides francis turbines, kaplan turbines, pelton wheel turbines, and micro hydro power gene
